audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side read 'Skill' while every win[N] read 'Irelia' — the page answered 'who wins Level 1' two different ways on all seven rows.
audit.why: At 53.87% Irelia is favoured overall, but levels 1-2 belong to Taliyah: Threaded Volley is 1000 range on a 7s cooldown and Seismic Shove throws Irelia back out of melee.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-1 to Taliyah, row 2 to Skill, rows 3-6 to Irelia; win[0], win[1] and win[2] edited to match. win[3..6] already read 'Irelia', so the side edit on those rows brings the two layers into agreement without a text change.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes were written generically; nothing named the cooldowns that gate them.
audit.why: Threaded Volley falls from 7s to 3s by rank 5 while Unraveled Earth stays a flat 14s and Weaver's Wall is 180/150/120 — the mines, not her poke, are what you time.
audit.corrected: Level 3, 4-5, 6 and first-item stages now key off those numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Unraveled Earth explicitly stuns enemies who DASH through it, which is exactly what Bladesurge does. The page also told you to parry with Defiant Dance, which reduces physical damage only.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.' Seismic Shove into the minefield is the whole combo, and Taliyah's damage is magic so W is not the answer.
audit.corrected: Mines-stun-your-dash stated in phases[2].why, cooldowns, dos and donts; W-parry line removed from early.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second' Seismic Shove.
audit.why: Seismic Shove is 14/12.5/11/9.5/8, Unraveled Earth a flat 14s, Weaver's Wall 180/150/120.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in and the 15s claim corrected to 14s at rank 1.

edits.before: At level 1-2 Taliyah wants to poke and kite using her terrain manipulation, so Irelia should look to shove the wave and dash onto minions to close the gap before she can seed enough ground to kite freely. Once Irelia is in melee range her trades are heavily favored, since Taliyah has little defense against sustained skirmish pressure up close. Use W's parry to block a key auto or E hit and heal the trade back. Watch for her roaming pattern and punish empty lane pushes.
edits.after: At level 1-2 Taliyah pokes from 1000 range with Threaded Volley on a 7s cooldown, so Irelia should keep low minions alive in the wave as Bladesurge targets rather than shoving them off, and close only when the poke is spent. Once Irelia is in melee range her trades are heavily favored, since Taliyah has little defense against sustained skirmish pressure up close. Defiant Dance cuts physical damage only and will not blunt her rocks. Watch her roam timers and punish empty lane pushes.
